mapper.select: select * FROM wms_material_inventory where material_is_whole = 1 and bool_delete_enum = 0 and warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and workshop_id = #{workshopId}
select * FROM wms_material_inventory where material_is_whole = 1 and bool_delete_enum = 0 -- and factory_id = #{sourceFactoryId}

select * FROM wms_material_inventory where bool_delete_enum = 0
and material_is_whole = #{materialIsWhole}
select * FROM wms_material_inventory where material_is_whole = 1 and bool_delete_enum = 0 and warehouse_id = #{directionWarehouseId} and factory_id = #{directionFactoryId}

select * FROM wms_material_inventory where bool_delete_enum = 0
AND material_is_whole = #{materialIsWhole}

select * from wms_material_inventory where bool_delete_enum = 0 and use_status = 0 and bool_virtual = 0 and bool_party_a = 0
and basic_class & #{ basicClass} > 0
and (
classify_name like CONCAT('%', #{name},'%')
)
select sum(mete) from wms_material_inventory where bool_delete_enum = 0 and classify_id = #{classifyId}

select wai.*, p.id pid, p.short_name psName, p.serial_number pSN, p.name pn, mbf.id mbfId, mbf.name mbfName, ww.id wwId, ww.name wwName FROM wms_material_inventory wai left join contract_project p on p.id = wai.project_id left join wms_workshop mbf on wai.workshop_id = mbf.id left join wms_warehouse ww on ww.id = wai.warehouse_id WHERE wai.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wai.bool_virtual = 0

select wmi.*, ww.id warehouseId, ww.name warehouseName, wm.measure_unit wmu, wm.measure_precision wmp, wm.accounting_unit wau, wm.accounting_precision wap, mf.id workshopId, mf.name workshopName from wms_material_inventory wmi left join wms_warehouse ww on wmi.warehouse_id = ww.id left join wms_workshop mf on mf.id = wmi.workshop_id left join wms_measure wm on wm.classification_id = wmi.classify_id where wmi.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wmi.classify_id in
#{classifyId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `wms_material_inventory` WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0 AND bool_nest_surplus=true and DATE_FORMAT(#{date}, '%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y%m%d')
select * from wms_material_inventory where id = #{id}

select * from wms_material_inventory where id in
#{id}
